images.scene: A man in a collared shirt, vest and rolled-up sleeves holding the front door of his modest house wide open in a welcoming gesture, half turned toward the doorway; around and behind him the living room is crammed with stacked cardboard boxes, furniture covered in white sheets and piled clutter. The man, the door and the mess are LARGE in the frame, filling the entire bottom half and bleeding off the bottom edge. The wall space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

Seen from inside a cluttered living room: stacked cardboard boxes and furniture covered in sheets fill the bottom foreground bleeding off the bottom edge, and in the middle distance a visitor in a long coat and hat stands still in the open front doorway, pausing to look at the mess. The visitor sits low in the frame, no face detail. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A long hallway of an old house with open doors on both sides, each open doorway revealing a room crammed with stacked boxes and piled furniture, clutter spilling onto the corridor floorboards. The hallway floor and the doorways sit low in the frame, filling the bottom half. The ceiling and upper walls dissolve into bright, pale, hazy emptiness.

A single closed wooden door at the end of a narrow hallway, the only closed door of the house, a thin strip of warm light leaking from under it, bare worn floorboards leading to it. The door sits low in the frame filling the bottom third. The hallway walls above dissolve into bright, pale, hazy emptiness.

Close view of a man's hands hastily wrapping a parcel in plain brown paper and twine on a cluttered wooden workbench, loose papers, tools and small boxes piled around the parcel. No face visible. The wrapping paper is completely plain with no lettering and no labels. The hands and bench fill the bottom third of the frame. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.
